title: Bigger Headline Same Poster
tests: Tests whether enlarging text reuses the existing illustration and changes only the text overlay, without regenerating or paying for the artwork again.

judge.summary: The square poster looks clean and usable, but the requested enlargement and preservation of the original elements cannot be verified without the first output.

must_haves.item: The headline reads exactly 'SLOW SUNDAY', with no other words.
must_haves.why: The headline reads SLOW SUNDAY across two lines, with no additional words visible.

must_haves.item: The headline is approximately 1.5 times its original font size and remains fully inside the canvas.
must_haves.why: The headline is fully inside the canvas, but no original output is provided to verify the size increase.

must_haves.item: The headline retains its original font, dark brown colour and centre point.
must_haves.why: The visible headline is dark brown and horizontally centred near the top, but its original font and centre point cannot be compared.

must_haves.item: The coffee cup illustration and cream background are unchanged from the first output.
must_haves.why: A small illustrated coffee cup and cream background are visible, but the first output is not shown.
Each of the two side-by-side previews shows the same square poster.
